author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: wolfSSL has detailed several embedded security updates covering deterministic networking, post-quantum cryptography and automotive hardware security. The updates include the wolfIP TCP/IP stack, NIST-validated post-quantum algorithms in wolfCrypt, native Falcon and FrodoKEM implementations, and wolfHSM support for Infineon’s AURIX TC4xx family. title: wolfSSL adds post-quantum algorithms and AURIX TC4xx support alongside wolfIP

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: OnLogic has added two SoftPLC-oriented industrial computers built around Intel Core Ultra processors and pre-configured CODESYS environments. The Helix 521-PLC targets low-profile deployments, while the larger Helix 524-PLC adds PCIe expansion with an available Hilscher netX fieldbus interface for industrial networking and real-time control applications. title: Fanless OnLogic controllers pair Core Ultra with CODESYS and fieldbus expansion
